name: @tengxiaohtx/agentic-html

tools.name: agentic_html_preview_html
tools.description: Open an HTML file in a live preview the human can annotate. Returns the preview URL, a session id, and the id of the initial version. Give the URL to the human and ask them to mark up what they want changed.

file_path.description: Path to the .html or .htm file to preview.

port.description: Port to listen on. 0 (the default) picks a free port.

watch.description: Reload the preview when the file changes on disk. Default true.

tools.name: agentic_html_close_preview
tools.description: Shut down a preview server and release its port.

tools.name: agentic_html_get_document_outline
tools.description: Return a structural tree of the document: tag, CSS selector and a text summary for each element. Call this first to orient yourself and to obtain valid selectors — selectors you pass to apply_patch should come from here or from get_region, not be guessed.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth to walk. Default 6.

tools.name: agentic_html_get_region
tools.description: Return a single element plus its surrounding context (parent, previous and next siblings). Region-scoped rather than whole-document so large pages do not blow your context budget. Use this to see exactly what you are about to change before calling apply_patch.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element of interest.

tools.name: agentic_html_get_dom_snapshot
tools.description: Return the raw HTML and a DOM tree for a version, optionally scoped to a selector. Prefer get_document_outline for orientation and get_region for a specific element — both are far cheaper in context.

selector.description: Restrict the snapshot to this subtree.

tools.name: agentic_html_get_activity
tools.description: Recent activity on this preview session: tool calls from any agent, human submissions, versions created, gate rejections. Useful for picking up where a previous session left off.

after_seq.description: Return only events with a sequence number above this. Default 0.

tools.name: agentic_html_get_annotations
tools.description: Fetch the annotations a human left on a version. Each carries a CSS selector, a text quote for drift detection, a node preview, and the human's comment describing what they want changed. This is your work list.

tools.name: agentic_html_get_annotation_screenshot
tools.description: Fetch the server-rendered screenshot of the region a human circled, as a base64 PNG data URL. This is a clean render of the version — no ink overlay — so you can see exactly what they pointed at. Returns available:false when no screenshot was captured (e.g. Playwright unavailable at submit time).

annotation_id.description: Annotation whose region screenshot to fetch.

tools.name: agentic_html_export_annotations
tools.description: Render a version's annotations as markdown or JSON — handy for summarizing the work list back to the human before you start editing.

include_screenshots.description: Embed screenshot data URLs. Default false — they are large.

tools.name: agentic_html_resolve_annotation
tools.description: Mark one annotation as handled once you have patched it, so the human can see which of their notes you have acted on.

tools.name: agentic_html_apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a set of targeted DOM edits and, if they pass validation, create a new version. Every selector is resolved against a frozen copy of the document before any edit runs, so patches cannot shift each other. The result is then checked by a structure gate (parses, balanced tags, no injected scripts, no changes outside your targets, something actually changed, selectors still unique). If the gate fails, NO version is created and you get a report naming the failing checks — fix the offending patch and call again.

version_id.description: Version to patch. The new version becomes its child.

patches.description: Patch objects: {selector, action, content?, old_content?, annotation_id?, quote?}. action is one of replace | delete | insert_before | insert_after | modify_style. For modify_style, content holds CSS declarations. old_content is an optimistic-concurrency check: if the target does not match it, that patch fails instead of overwriting something unexpected.

verify.description: Also render both versions in a headless browser and compare them pixel by pixel. Off by default because it adds several seconds; turn it on when a change is visually risky and you want proof nothing else moved.

tools.name: agentic_html_preview_patch
tools.description: Apply patches in memory and return the resulting HTML and diff without creating a version. Use this to check your edits land where you intend before committing them.
